For each digit \(d\), exactly one previous digit \(k\) satisfies \(|d-k|=5\), so \(f(n,d)=S_{n-1}-f(n-1,k)\). Summing over all \(d=0,\dots,9\):

\[
S_n = 10S_{n-1} - S_{n-1} = 9S_{n-1}.
\]

With \(S_1=10\),

\[
S_6 = 10\cdot 9^5 = 590490.
\]

Thus the number of excellent tickets is

\[
1000000 - 590490 = 409510.
\]

\[
\boxed{409510}
\]
